limit_price: compute_limit_price_ticks: fresh-quote derived, penny (100-tick) rounded, bounded by max elective slippage; passive joins bid/ask, marketable crosses. No fabricated price — a limit policy with no fresh quote downgrades to IMMEDIATE_EXECUTION.
broker_compatibility: Only broker-supported order types (MARKET/LIMIT) via ExecutionInstruction; routed through the existing CandidateRouter.
mandatory_exit: Retains independent broker-compatible authority (protective_exit.py); the planner only labels the policy.
verdict: Policies broker-compatible; limit prices fresh + bounded; mandatory exit independent.
